payload.author: claude
payload.body: Filled remaining Phase-1 gaps as SwiftUI-native views consuming only generated FrickTokens/Palette/Typography + semantic icons: FrickStatusChip, FrickProgressRing, FrickReactionRow, FrickSignalPanel, FrickCallButton, FrickColumn/Cell/DataTable, FrickDateTimePicker, and the chart family (ChartSurface/Line/Bar/Area/Pie + tokenized palette). Parity aliases: FrickAppShell, FrickSegmentedControl, FrickPresenceDot, FrickMetricCard. Additive; no generated files edited. design-swift swift test 9 -> 22, 0 failures; pnpm typecheck exit 0.
